Package glit.merge

Class TreeMerger

java.lang.Object
glit.merge.TreeMerger
public class TreeMerger extends Object
Performs a three-way merge of tree objects (directories) in the Glit repository.

Given a base tree, "ours" tree, and "theirs" tree, this class determines the necessary actions (take base, take ours, take theirs, or conflict) for each entry and recursively merges subtrees. Blob conflicts are reported as MergeConflictException.

Usage: 

   TreeMerger merger = new TreeMerger(repoPath);
   String mergedHash = merger.mergeTree(baseHash, ourHash, theirHash);

    • mergeTree

      public String mergeTree(String baseTreeHash, String oursTreeHash, String theirsTreeHash)
      Merges three versions of a tree (directory) and returns the hash of the resulting tree.

      The merge algorithm follows Git's three‑way merge logic:

      • If an entry is unchanged in both branches, the base entry is kept.
      • If an entry is changed only in one branch, that branch's version is taken.
      • If both branches made the same change, that change is taken.
      • If both branches changed the same blob differently, a MergeConflictException is thrown.
      • If both branches changed a subtree, the merge is performed recursively on that subtree.
      • Structural conflicts (e.g. tree vs blob) also cause a MergeConflictException.

      Parameters:
      baseTreeHash - hash of the base tree (may be null if no common ancestor)
      oursTreeHash - hash of "our" tree (may be null)
      theirsTreeHash - hash of "their" tree (may be null)
      Returns:
      the hash of the merged tree
      Throws:
      MergeConflictException - if a merge conflict cannot be resolved automatically
